summary: This CFI article explains the business model canvas template, a strategic planning tool that condenses a business plan into an executive-summary style overview. It describes the template's origin in Alexander Osterwalder's 2004 thesis and walks through its nine building blocks, with considerations and examples for each. The note is cut off in the middle of the Revenue Streams section, where Apple is mentioned as having multiple revenue streams.
one_line: CFI guide to the nine-block business model canvas template, its 2004 origins with Alexander Osterwalder, and examples for each building block.
key_facts: The business model canvas is a strategic planning tool used by managers to illustrate and develop their business model.
The business model canvas template acts like an executive summary for the business plan.
Alexander Osterwalder originally introduced the business model canvas template in his 2004 thesis, 'The Business Model Ontology – A Proposition in a Design Science Approach'.

The business model canvas template has nine main building blocks: Key Partners, Key Activities, Key Resources, Value Propositions, Customer Relationships, Channels, Customer Segments, Cost Structure, and Revenue Streams.
The note says Value Propositions are arguably the most important element of the business model canvas template.
Spotify's value proposition, 'Music for everyone.', eloquently states its mission and offering.
A diamond mining company cannot operate without mining equipment, an example of a key resource.
Telecommunications companies often have poor reputations for customer relationships because many practice aggressive and predatory sales practices through their call centers.
Amazon needs to integrate its fulfillment centers and shipping services so that timely shipments are sent out, an example given under Channels.
Airlines offer tickets for economy, business, and first-class customers, an example given under Customer Segments.
Forever 21 is described as a fast-fashion, cost-driven company focused on delivering the newest styles at low costs.
Gucci is described as a luxury, value-driven brand focused on high-quality clothes and accessories designed with the latest trends.
Revenue streams are a company's source of cash flows and are the final element of the business model canvas template.
The note says Apple has multiple revenue streams, but the sentence is cut off at 'between its'.
